5.en: Our strategy is to save a little money each week.
5.zh: 我们的策略是每周存一点钱。

10.en: The editor found a flaw in the final page of the report.
10.zh: 编辑在报告最后一页发现了一个缺陷。

11.en: The café caters to people who need a quiet place to work.
11.zh: 这家咖啡馆为需要安静工作场所的人提供服务。

18.en: Her decision was based on logic, not fear.
18.zh: 她的决定基于逻辑，而不是恐惧。

19.en: Use the index at the back to find the topic.
19.zh: 用书末的索引查找这个主题。

24.en: The student was expelled for repeatedly breaking the rules.
24.zh: 这名学生因屡次违反规定而被开除。

29.en: The city will enforce the new parking rules next month.
29.zh: 市政府下个月将执行新的停车规定。

31.en: Save a backup of your photos before replacing the phone.
31.zh: 更换手机前，请备份照片。

37.en: He was reluctant to speak in front of the class.
37.zh: 他不太愿意在全班面前发言。

38.en: The rope is under strain, so do not pull it harder.
38.zh: 绳子正承受着拉力，不要再用力拉。

47.en: Do not click a link if it looks like a trap.
47.zh: 如果链接看起来像个圈套，就不要点击。

59.en: This ticket entitles you to one free drink.
59.zh: 这张票可以让你免费领取一杯饮料。
